label: RUDY wire density
subgoals: Take the net's bounding box width and height
Divide the HPWL by the box area for the density
Clamp degenerate boxes to a minimum size

label: Demand per bin
subgoals: Clip each net's box to the bin
Multiply the overlap area by the net's density
Sum over nets for the bin's demand

label: From demand to congestion and action
section: From demand to congestion and action
subgoals: Compute bin capacity from layers, area and track pitch
Divide demand by capacity for the congestion ratio
Act on bins above 1 by inflation or lower target density
